policy: Highway is the maintenance default for same-contract standard primitives. xsimd requires an existing material advantage before a narrower fixed-width scope is created; token availability alone does not trigger another benchmark.
scalable_scope_disposition: The 78 pending legacy scopes that include SVE or RVV cannot be fully implemented by xsimd's fixed-width batch. No existing material xsimd evidence authorizes splitting those scopes, so Highway remains the default without another timing matrix.

fixed_or_facade_findings.reason: xsimd can spell the arbitrary-bit blend from bitwise operators, but has no distinct algorithm or material evidence against Highway's direct primitive.
HYLE consumes one interleaved real vector; xsimd::batch<std::complex<T>> owns separate real/imag batches, so a representation bridge is not the same register contract.
xsimd reduce_max returns one scalar; matching HYLE's broadcast-vector result requires an additional broadcast and has no independent material evidence.
xsimd reduce_min returns one scalar; matching HYLE's broadcast-vector result requires an additional broadcast and has no independent material evidence.
HYLE Mod consumes a reusable precomputed invariant Divisor; xsimd remainder/fmod consumes a batch divisor and does not provide the same setup/amortization contract.

xsimd mul_hilo returns {high, low}; a zero-cost field reorder matches HYLE's low return/high out contract, but the locked AVX2 implementation uses the same 32-bit partial-product construction and has no material winner evidence.
xsimd fms and Highway/HYLE lower to the target FMA form when available; no different algorithm or material xsimd evidence exists.
nearbyint_as_int has an explicit silent-overflow warning and its complete exceptional/out-of-range behavior has not been qualified against HYLE's signed-vector conversion contract.
xsimd fnms is the same fused arithmetic shape on applicable targets and has no material evidence that justifies a separate provider route.
xsimd widen returns two full batches and its common fallback stores and reloads memory; this is not HYLE/Highway's selected-half D-tag result contract.
xsimd batch_bool is bound to its batch lane/architecture representation; public bitwise_cast does not establish HYLE's cross-lane-type mask rebind contract.
xsimd exposes the raw reciprocal estimate (or division fallback), not a distinct one-Newton-step primitive; composing the same refinement has no algorithmic advantage over Highway primitives.
xsimd exposes the raw rsqrt estimate; matching HYLE requires the same Newton composition and has no independent material winner evidence.

known_outside_register_inventory.reason: The certified current-peer report records matching special-case outputs, 1 ULP xsimd versus 2 ULP Highway, and a material throughput advantage at 4096 and 1048576 elements in both orders.

conclusion: No additional primitive xsimd timing matrix is justified. Keep the known tanh family candidate; choose Highway for unresolved standard primitives and use existing HYLE/Highway material evidence for finite HYLE exceptions.
